tips.trainsText: Tickets carry your passport details, so bring the passport you booked with. High-speed seats sell out in spring and autumn — book early.
tips.metroText: Tashkent’s metro is quick and cheap. Pay with a contactless card or a QR ticket; the stations are worth seeing in themselves.
tips.taxiText: Use a ride-hailing app or a taxi your hotel calls. On the street, agree the fare before you get in.
tips.sharedText: Pay per seat; cars leave from fixed stands when full. Buy two seats if you want more room.
tips.flightsText: Arrive 90 minutes before departure. Hand luggage rules are strict on smaller aircraft.
tips.payText: Cards work in cities; keep some cash in soʻm for bazaars, shared taxis and small towns.
